description_en: Modifies a notification for Auto Scaling events and resource changes
description_zh: 修改一条弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知
kebab_example: aliyun ess modify-notification-configuration --scaling-group-id asg-bp1igpak5ft1flyp0000 --notification-arn acs:ess:cn-beijing:1614568843400000:cloudmonitor --notification-type AUTOSCALING:SCALE_OUT_SUCCESS --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyNotificationConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The identity of the Notification Recipient. The following notification methods are supported when you configure the Settings for this parameter:

CloudMonitor monitoring. The parameter value is in the format of `acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`.
MNS queue. The parameter value is in the format of `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`.
MNS topic. The parameter value is in the format of `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`.

The variables in the parameter format have the following meanings:
region-id: the region ID of the scaling group.
account-id: the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
queuename: the name of the MNS queue.
topicname: the name of the MNS topic
parameters.help_zh:
通知对象标识符，设置本参数时支持以下通知方式：

云监控，参数取值格式：`acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`。
MNS队列，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`。
MNS主题，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`。

参数格式中的变量含义如下：
region-id：伸缩组所在的地域的ID。
account-id：阿里云账号ID。
queuename：MNS队列的名称。
topicname：MNS主题的名称
parameters.name: notification_arn

parameters.help_en: One or more types of Auto Scaling event and resource change notifications. Valid values of N: 1 to 8
parameters.help_zh: 一类或者多类弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知，N的取值范围：1~8
parameters.name: notification_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The time zone for message notifications.
The offset relative to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), such as UTC+8 or UTC-7
parameters.help_zh:
消息通知的时区。
时区相对于协调世界时的偏移量： 如 UTC+8（东八区）、UTC-7（西七区）等
parameters.name: time_zone

parameters.help_en:
The encoding method for the notification content. Valid values:

PlainText: no encoding. The content is transmitted in plaintext.
Base64: Base64 encoding.

Default value: Base64.

This parameter can be set only for MNS Notification Recipient Settings
parameters.help_zh:
消息通知内容的编码方式。取值范围：

PlainText：不编码，采用明文传输。
Base64：Base64 编码。

默认值：Base64。

仅支持MNS通知对象设置该参数
parameters.name: message_encoding
